dogecoin.text: @elonmusk , good afternoon Elon Musk, I hope everything is fine with you, I have several cryptocurrencies including Dogecoin and XRP, I'm a fan of them, but since I don't have a lot of money I ended up choosing to buy BTT too, I believe that Dogecoin, XRP and BTT are the future .
